annotations.title: Check Prompt Size Against Long-Context Pricing Cliffs

description: Evaluates whether a prompt token count crosses vendor long-context surcharge cliffs (100K on Claude Haiku, 128K on GPT-4o, 200K on Claude/Gemini Pro, or 272K on GPT-6.1 Sol) and computes the exact surcharge impact. Deterministic lookup against the embedded rate-card catalog requiring no API keys. Returns JSON with crosses_cliff_boolean, cliff_threshold_tokens, headroom_tokens, active_surcharge_multiplier, extra_cliff_surcharge_usd, and recommended_flat_context_model. Use this tool before sending prompts above 90K tokens to avoid 2x cliff surcharges; use compress_and_fold_context instead to shrink verbose logs below the cliff.

model.description: Model ID ('vendor/model-slug') to evaluate against long-context pricing cliffs.

prompt_tokens.description: Input prompt token count to test against vendor cliff thresholds.

name: check_context_cliff
